skill.name: website-traffic-checker
skill.description: Comprehensive website traffic analysis workflow. Use when the user asks to analyze a website's traffic, check competitor traffic, analyze best-performing content, see keywords driving traffic, or assess page performance. Supports Similarweb, Ahrefs (via MCP), Semrush (via API), DataForSEO (via MCP), and user-uploaded data exports (CSV/XLSX from GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, etc.).
skill.userDescription: Comprehensive website traffic analysis workflow supporting Similarweb, Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO, and exported analytics data.
exampleQuestions: Check the monthly traffic and top organic keywords for stripe.com
Analyze our competitor's traffic breakdown and best-performing pages using this exported GSC CSV file
Compare the traffic trends and keyword distribution between github.com and gitlab.com
